title: LDBC SNB install target and blocker refresh
objective: Move the strict native LDBC blocker from an ad hoc missing-artifact state into the common external benchmark install/bootstrap workflow, without claiming native LDBC success before a real artifact and workload command exist.
scope: Add LDBC SNB as a first-class install_external_tools.ps1 target.
Keep LDBC discovery bounded to expected local tool/artifact locations so diagnostics finish quickly.
Emit explicit environment configuration and native smoke commands when an artifact is configured or locally discoverable.
Refresh LDBC bootstrap/native smoke/external smoke evidence with artifact_missing as the current blocker.
verification: python -m py_compile external_bootstrap.py external_smoke.py ldbc_snb_native_smoke.py bench_gate.py
current_environment_result: Java/JDBC prerequisites exist and LDBC native smoke generated config evidence, but no LDBC_SNB_HOME/LDBC_DRIVER_HOME or local LDBC artifact is configured. Native LDBC remains artifact_missing by design.
next_candidates: Place or build the LDBC SNB driver/datagen distribution under E:\Playground\ldbc-snb.
Run install_external_tools.ps1 -Target ldbc again and configure LDBC_SNB_HOME.
Run ldbc_snb_native_smoke.py with run-mode=help against the configured artifact.
Provide an explicit --ldbc-command template for the chosen distribution and capture the first real schema/import/workload gap.
